title: Poisson2Gaussian: Noise Gaussianization to Enhance Image Denoising

"""Record primary reading and an independent information-preservation check."""
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');source=repo/'.cache/research-20261107/arxiv-2606.23098v1.html'
assert source.is_file()
values=[]
for observed in [np.array([2.,4.,2.,4.]),np.array([4.,8.,4.,8.])]:
    estimate=observed/2
    scale=np.std(observed-estimate)
    normalized=(observed-estimate)/scale
    transformed=-normalized  # This flow is bijective,with inverse itself.
    restored_observation=estimate-scale*transformed
    collapsed=estimate+scale*transformed
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(restored_observation,observed)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(collapsed,np.zeros_like(observed))
    values.append({'observed':observed.tolist(),'estimate':estimate.tolist(),'scale':float(scale),
        'transformed_residual':transformed.tolist(),'tuple_inverse':restored_observation.tolist(),
        'collapsed_input':collapsed.tolist()})
output=repo/'docs/results/poisson2gaussian-reading-20261107-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'primary-reading-and-independent-algebra-check-only','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),

    'primary_url':'https://arxiv.org/html/2606.23098v1','version_date':'2026-06-22',
    'cached_primary_HTML':ref(source),'sections_read':['3.1-3.3','4.1-4.4','5'],
    'paper_summary':'P2G alternates residual-flow likelihood fitting with denoiser updates. It evaluates packed SIDD RAW and microscopy denoising;this is not our joint16-bit/GFX task.',
    'our_inference':'The left-invertible augmented tuple in3.2 does not alone prove that the collapsed denoiser input in3.3 is left-invertible. Retain the original observation explicitly in future representations. This logical gap does not negate the reported empirical results.',
